canonical_equations: p=b0-a0;q=b1-a1;d=q-p;t=clamp(-dot(p,d)/dot(d,d),0,1);zero rounded motion selects0;min_d2=|p+t*d|^2;contact=min_d2<=(ra+rb)^2;ordered RN32;exact endpoint reuse at t0/1.
input_contract: binary32 pairs[N,14]=[a0.xyz,a1.xyz,b0.xyz,b1.xyz,ra,rb];N1..4096;radii>=0;finite executed intermediates; simultaneous endpoints in one frame and consistent units.
output_contract: N x [u32 contact;f32 closest_fraction,min_d2,start_d2,end_d2,radius_sum_d2;u32 rounded_stationary];inclusive rounded contact;not first-contact time or a conservative geometric proof.
result_contract: N x [u32 contact;f32 closest_fraction,min_d2,start_d2,end_d2,radius_sum_d2;u32 rounded_stationary];inclusive rounded contact;not first-contact time or a conservative geometric proof.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
